telemetry.title: Help improve Onlook
telemetry.subtitle: Share usage data to help us decide what to improve.
telemetry.details: Onlook sends usage events and basic device information to PostHog. Source builds never send session recordings, diagnostic logs, error reports, code, file paths, or chat messages.
telemetry.choice: Nothing is sent until you choose. You can change your choice in Settings → Global → Privacy.
telemetry.settings.label: Share usage data
telemetry.settings.description: Help improve Onlook by sending usage events and basic device information to PostHog. No session recordings, logs, error reports, code, file paths, or chat messages.
telemetry.settings.removed: Telemetry was removed from this build. No usage data is sent.
